title: Updated current workshop kit loan
subtitle: The handbook is retained and a conflicting FAQ is added
disclaimer: Fictional current-state example from two documents with unresolved authority. Statements are declared, not observed behavior. The conflict, experience, frequency and financial effects remain unresolved.

sources.label: Operations handbook · 2026-07-10
sources.text: Employees email the facilities inbox with the requested date and team name. A coordinator copies each request into the loan spreadsheet and checks the cupboard. The coordinator does not send an acknowledgement before the check is complete and emails either a collection message or an unavailable message. The handbook sets no response deadline. For available kits, the employee signs a paper sheet at the reception desk and collects the labelled kit; the spreadsheet row remains the support record. The employee later returns the kit to reception, where the receptionist puts it back into reception stock. The handbook does not describe late returns.

sources.label: Customer FAQ · 2026-08-02
sources.text: Every kit request receives a confirmation email within one business day, even when the availability check is still in progress. The FAQ does not say whether it supersedes the operations handbook.
